{{Quote|A captive Seppie tank just opened fire in the cargo bay of our command ship! The boys up there could really use a hand getting it under control!|Commander Jet|<ref name="CWA" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tank]] was sent to a [[Unidentified Venator-class Star Destroyer (super tank)|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]. However, once aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s inside the tank began an '''attack''' on the cruiser, destroying its cargo bay. With the clone troopers unable to stop the tank, [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Jet/Legends|Jet]] sent a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] to destroy the tank and the enemy [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].
